title: USC OIS: Guidelines for Maintaining Status (curated summary)
text:
USC F-1 enrollment: OIS lists the full-time enrollment requirements on its Guidelines for Maintaining Status page. In fall and spring, degree-applicable study is normally required. The minimum is 12 units for undergraduates, 8 for master's students, 8 for graduate-certificate students, and 6 for PhD students. Master's/PhD students with an assistantship have a 6-unit minimum. A program may require additional units; progressive-degree students should consult the separate PDP guidance.
USC F-1 instruction rules: attend the classroom components of in-person and hybrid courses. Only one online course, worth at most 3 units, may count toward the required full-time load. A sole remaining course in the last semester must use in-person or hybrid instruction.
USC F-1 enrollment exceptions: summer is generally optional except for the first or last term or a departmental requirement. Students starting in summer need a full load in their initial summer session. An approved reduced course load can provide an exception; review the linked OIS RCL guidance.
curation_note: Concise paraphrase checked against the linked USC page via web retrieval. Not a complete page snapshot or a substitute for OIS advice.
